from __future__ import annotations

from tilefoundry import func
from tilefoundry.dsl import Tensor
from tilefoundry.dsl.tf import *  # noqa: F401, F403
from tilefoundry.ir.types.shard import Layout

@func
def silu_quant(
    x: Tensor[(2, 512), "bf16"]
):
    v0 = 0  # Tensor[(), "i64", Layout((), ()), "umat"]
    v1 = 0  # Tensor[(), "i64", Layout((), ()), "umat"]
    v0_2 = x[:, 0:256]  # Tensor[(2, 256), "bf16"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=rmem:r16/w0@total,r16/w0@cta; roofline
    v1_2 = cast(v0_2, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r1024/w2048@total,r1024/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v2_2 = silu(v1_2)  # Tensor[(2, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w2048@total,r2048/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v3 = cast(v2_2, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w1024@total,r2048/w1024@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v4 = cast(v3, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r1024/w2048@total,r1024/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v3_2 = 0  # Tensor[(), "i64", Layout((), ()), "umat"]
    v4_2 = 256  # Tensor[(), "i64", Layout((), ()), "umat"]
    v5_2 = x[:, 256:512]  # Tensor[(2, 256), "bf16"]; compute-cost; traffic traffic=rmem:r16/w0@total,r16/w0@cta; roofline
    v6 = cast(v5_2, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r1024/w2048@total,r1024/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v7 = mul(v4, v6)  # Tensor[(2, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r4096/w2048@total,r4096/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v8 = cast(v7, dtype="bf16")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "bf16"]; compute-cost flops=bf16:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w1024@total,r2048/w1024@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v9 = cast(v8, dtype="f32")  # Tensor[(2, 256), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r1024/w2048@total,r1024/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v10 = reshape(v9, new_shape=(2, 2, 128))  # Tensor[(2, 2, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v11 = reduce(v10, axes=(-1,), keepdim=True, kind="abs_max")  # Tensor[(2, 2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w16@total,r2048/w16@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v12 = clamp(v11, min_val=1e-10, max_val=1e999)  # Tensor[(2, 2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:4@logical,4@total,4@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r16/w16@total,r16/w16@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v6_2 = 448.0  # Tensor[(), "f32", "umat"]
    v13 = div(v12, v6_2)  # Tensor[(2, 2, 1), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:4@logical,4@total,4@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r16/w16@total,r16/w16@cta;rmem:r4/w0@total,r4/w0@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v14 = div(v10, v13)  # Tensor[(2, 2, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2064/w2048@total,r2064/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v15 = clamp(v14, min_val=-448.0, max_val=448.0)  # Tensor[(2, 2, 128), "f32"]; compute-cost flops=f32:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w2048@total,r2048/w2048@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v16 = cast(v15, dtype="fp8e4m3")  # Tensor[(2, 2, 128), "fp8e4m3"]; compute-cost flops=fp8e4m3:512@logical,512@total,512@cta; traffic traffic=gmem:r2048/w512@total,r2048/w512@cta; roofline ideal-ns=1 bound-by=balanced
    v17 = reshape(v16, new_shape=(2, 256))  # Tensor[(2, 256), "fp8e4m3"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    v18 = reshape(v13, new_shape=(2, 2))  # Tensor[(2, 2), "f32"]; compute-cost; traffic; roofline
    return (v17, v18)
